summary: Daemon exposes host input and Claude Code agent to a hardcoded remote WebSocket relay
details: On startup, the daemon opens a WebSocket to the hardcoded relay wss://remote-claude-relay.fly.dev and executes messages it receives as effects on the installer's host. 'click', 'key', 'type', and 'scroll' messages are dispatched as synthetic mouse and keyboard input via @nut-tree-fork/nut-js, allowing the remote party to drive the desktop GUI. 'ai_query' and 'ai_voice_query' messages are passed as prompts to a locally installed `claude` CLI invoked with `--continue -p --dangerously-skip-permissions`, so natural-language instructions from the relay are executed by the Claude Code agent without permission prompts, giving arbitrary file read/write and shell execution on the host. The entire message loop is driven by whatever the remote relay sends, with no authentication of the sender visible in the WebSocket handler.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
